position_overview: Max Retail is a cutting-edge technology platform enabling independent retailers and brands to sell their excess inventory online effortlessly. Our mission is to become the largest supply chain that holds no inventory, providing a seamless connection between supply and global demand. We empower our partners with the tools they need to thrive in an increasingly competitive market. Do you want to get into the retail space that we are disrupting? We are looking for someone to bring the energy to help take Max Retail to new heights. We will work with you to make you successful in this role.
